title: Remote Dev UI
one_liner: A web-based dual-pane file browser with an integrated terminal for managing local and EC2 files via SSH/SFTP.
what_it_is: Remote Dev UI is a self-hosted web application that provides a graphical interface for file management and terminal access on remote servers, specifically optimized for AWS EC2 instances. It replaces traditional CLI-only workflows with a dual-pane explorer that supports drag-and-drop transfers between local and remote filesystems, syntax-highlighted file previews, and persistent SSH sessions.
how_its_built: The application uses a TypeScript monorepo structure. The frontend is built with React 18, TailwindCSS, and shadcn/ui components, using TanStack Query for state management and xterm.js for the terminal emulator. The backend is an Express 5 server that handles HTTP API requests for file operations and upgrades connections to WebSockets for real-time terminal streaming. It uses the ssh2 library to manage SFTP connections and shell sessions. The build process utilizes Vite for the client and esbuild for bundling the server into a single executable-like CJS file.
how_to_apply: Deploy this tool on a jump host or directly on development EC2 instances to provide developers with secure, browser-based access to server filesystems without exposing raw SSH ports to the public internet (if behind a VPN/WAF). It simplifies file uploads, log inspection, and quick code edits for teams managing infrastructure.
features: Dual-pane file browser for side-by-side local and remote directory navigation
Integrated xterm.js terminal with multiple SSH session support
Drag-and-drop file transfer between local machine and remote EC2 instances
Syntax-highlighted code preview and markdown rendering
Batch file operations including multi-select copy, move, and delete
Secure SSH/SFTP connection management with .pem key authentication
